name: Decluttering When Overwhelmed
equipment: One drawer, desk, or inbox to start with
instructions: Pick just one small area (a drawer, your desktop, one email folder) instead of trying to declutter everything at once.
Sort into three piles: keep, deal with later, and remove -- do not let "maybe" turn into a fourth, endless pile.
Set a short timer (10-15 minutes); decluttering in short bursts is far more sustainable than a marathon session.
Watch today's video for a gentler approach to decluttering when it feels like too much.
